name: Audio Diarized Transcriber
description: Transcribe audio AND label who's speaking when -- per file, returns a list of {speaker, start_seconds, end_seconds, text} segments instead of one flat transcript string. Two backends: google_cloud_speech (cloud, native diarization) or pyannote (local pyannote.audio + local Whisper).

inputs.description: Input DataFrame with a column of audio file paths.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame with a segments column (list of {speaker, start_seconds, end_seconds, text} dicts) and a segments_transcript column (plain-text concatenation) added.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of audio file paths -- e.g. video_audio_extract_asset's output, or synthetic_audio_generator for a quick test fixture.

audio_path_column.label: Audio Path Column
audio_path_column.description: Column containing local audio file paths. Defaults to 'audio_path' to pair directly with video_audio_extract_asset's output_path_column.

output_column.label: Output Column
output_column.description: Column to write speaker-attributed segments into: a list of {speaker, start_seconds, end_seconds, text} dicts per row, one per contiguous speaker turn, ordered by start_seconds. Speaker labels are 'speaker_1', 'speaker_2', ... (relative numbering per file, not a stable identity across files).

transcript_column.label: Transcript Column
transcript_column.description: Column to write the full plain-text transcript into (all segments' text joined in order, speaker labels omitted). Defaults to '<output_column>_transcript'.

diarization_backend.label: Diarization Backend
diarization_backend.description: 'google_cloud_speech' (default): Cloud Speech-to-Text v2's native diarization, one cloud API call per file, no heavy local install. 'pyannote': local pyannote.audio (diarization) + local Whisper (transcription) -- free after setup, but needs your own HuggingFace token (gated model). See README before choosing this backend.

credentials.label: Credentials (dict)
credentials.description: google_cloud_speech backend: service account JSON as a dict. Falls back to credentials_path, then GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

credentials_path.label: Credentials Path
credentials_path.description: google_cloud_speech backend: path to a service-account JSON file.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: google_cloud_speech backend: GCP project ID. Defaults to the one embedded in the credentials.

location.label: Location
location.description: google_cloud_speech backend: recognizer region -- 'global' or a specific region (e.g. 'us-central1').

language_codes.label: Language Codes
language_codes.description: google_cloud_speech backend: one or more BCP-47 language codes.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: google_cloud_speech backend: retries per file on transient API errors.

rate_limit_delay.label: Rate Limit Delay
rate_limit_delay.description: google_cloud_speech backend: seconds to sleep between files.

pyannote_pipeline.label: Pyannote Pipeline
pyannote_pipeline.description: pyannote backend: HuggingFace pipeline id. This is a gated model -- accept its terms on huggingface.co with the account that owns hf_token_env_var before first use.

hf_token_env_var.label: HF Token Env Var
hf_token_env_var.description: pyannote backend: env var holding a HuggingFace access token with access to pyannote_pipeline.

whisper_model_size.label: Whisper Model Size
whisper_model_size.description: pyannote backend: local Whisper model size used to transcribe each detected speaker turn.

whisper_language.label: Whisper Language
whisper_language.description: pyannote backend: hint language for Whisper (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'en') to skip auto-detection per segment.

min_speakers.label: Min Speakers
min_speakers.description: pyannote backend: minimum expected speakers (omit to let pyannote infer).

max_speakers.label: Max Speakers
max_speakers.description: pyannote backend: maximum expected speakers (omit to let pyannote infer).

max_segments_per_file.label: Max Segments Per File
max_segments_per_file.description: pyannote backend: safety cap on speaker turns transcribed per file -- guards against a noisy/misdetected file producing thousands of tiny turns and burning huge Whisper runtime.

min_segment_seconds.label: Min Segment Seconds
min_segment_seconds.description: pyannote backend: speaker turns shorter than this are dropped before transcription -- pyannote frequently emits sub-100ms micro-turns at speaker-change boundaries that are too short for Whisper to transcribe meaningfully.

ffmpeg_binary.label: Ffmpeg Binary
ffmpeg_binary.description: pyannote backend: ffmpeg binary used to cut each speaker turn into its own audio slice.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5'.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when include_preview_metadata is True.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.
